input: After CPU4 wakes from deep idle, the GIC-600 Redistributor for CPU4 is still powered down when the first interrupt arrives. dmesg shows: GIC: CPU4: Redistributor not powered, interrupt lost. We wake the CPU then immediately try to route an SPI to it. What is the correct Redistributor wake sequence and how does GICR_WAKER.ProcessorSleep relate to interrupt delivery?
